title: Business gallery roles keep documentary photo provenance despite a specific planner wish
steps: Run the export provenance and gallery fill suites on this branch.
expect: The template business.gallery_image role rejects drawn and extended photos even when a planner requests specific pictures without observed facts.
Rejected pictures and their twins never reach mapped changes, uploads or alt text.
Gallery photo reuse remains available without drawing rungs; generic illustrations retain their existing behavior.
fence: The kit role establishes documentary purpose independently of the planner wish.

tests: a business gallery role rejects drawn even when the plan asks for a specific illustration
a business gallery role rejects owner-photo-extended even when the plan asks for a specific illustration
a specific business gallery keeps the real-photo reuse ladder without any drawing rung
